latest.environment: Codex @Computer; Themis dev app at localhost:1420
latest.notes: Native @Computer first reproduced the issue with a general-knowledge game-plan prompt that prohibited tools: no Activities row appeared, but bold section-label paragraphs shimmered while streaming. The cause was the stale Vite transformed CSS still serving the old .themis-thread-msg--live .themis-response > p shimmer rule after the source rule had been removed. Restarted Vite on port 1420; its served stylesheet now omits that selector and retains the separate action-waiting selector. A fresh no-tool plan produced no Activities row, and completed headings rendered static. During the post-restart run, the capture showed Thinking before answer tokens, then the full answer after generation had completed, so the brief in-progress heading state was not visually captured; marked blocked pending that specific capture.

plannedEnvironment: Current Tauri app with a text-only local response fixture.
